brief.whyItMatters: TypeScript is your default language. Compiler and ecosystem changes affect build speed, strictness and what the types can prove.

keyConcepts.explanation: Types vanish at runtime, so data from outside is checked by a schema at the boundary and only then trusted as typed.
TypeScript compares shapes, not names. A value fits a type when it has the required members, wherever it was declared.
